blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Supreme Court has junked the combined habeas corpus pleas contesting former president Rodrigo Duterte’s March 2025 handover to the ICC, ruling he is beyond its enforcement power. In its ruling, the Supreme Court noted that Duterte is not only outside its enforcement reach, but is also currently facing charges before an […]...
